preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'MF' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of the characters 'M' and 'F'.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the number of seconds needed to move all girls in front of boys.
The number of seconds needed is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: seconds_needed == 0 if 'M' not in stdin or 'F' not in stdin else True
postconditions.description: If the line has only boys or only girls, the number of seconds needed is 0.
